name: idli-ui
description: Idli UI — the Idlistack component library and documentation site.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @idlistack/ui && concurrently -k -n ui,docs -c magenta,blue "npm run dev -w @idlistack/ui" "npm run dev -w docs"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @idlistack/ui && npm run build -w docs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @idlistack/ui && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
